correctness.rationale: Complete exact enumeration of all 52360 four-sets and 324632 five-sets gives 0 and 149184 resolving subsets. Two separate predicates (BFS distance and intersection signatures) agree. The 6331500 undirected edges and connectivity are checked twice. The 48 S7 orbits are independently generated by all six adjacent ground-symbol transpositions; full BFS from each representative covers all 149184 configurations, proving eccentricity split 146160 at 5 and 3024 at 6 and hence radius 5 and diameter 6. Two six-step witnesses are independently replayed.

Bailey et al. prove the Odd/Johnson equivalence but no exhaustive five-base count or exchange-diameter bound. Targeted mathematical and scholarly queries found no stronger covering statement. value.rationale: The classical fourth Odd graph is the next Odd graph after the Petersen graph, with minimum landmark count five already known. The complete optimal-basis landscape, 48 symmetry types, connectivity and sharp six-exchange transformation bound answer a natural robustness/reconfiguration question unaddressed by a metric-dimension value. The result is a motivated complete finite classification with a real structural distinction, not an arbitrary slice.
